title: 第1981章 大结局第1980章 压根不现实
lines: 第1981章大结局
让她无法割舍，更是在她的心里根深蒂固。
君二爷牵着君雅思的手，此刻的心里也是感概万分，显然没有想到自己竟然会有一天，牵着侄女的手，将她送往幸福的地方。
虽然自己女儿还没结婚，但是当他牵着君雅思的手站在这台子上的这一刻，竟然生出了身为亲身父亲的感概。
若是大哥在世，此刻他的内心恐怕会是自己一样的心情。
她们终于长大了，如今跟自己心爱的男人结婚，组成了新的家庭。
大哥大嫂在天之灵，也算是欣慰了。
他们的女儿都很好，就算是自己做错过事情，但还是会选择原谅。
如果不是他们的原谅，自己如今也不会体会到这样的情绪。
牵着君雅思的手，一步一步的走向顾少卿。
漫天的花瓣不断的飘落，婚礼现场浪漫而又温馨，让人心间的幸福感瞬间被充盈。
看着整朝着自己走来的君雅思，这个自己爱了那么多年的女人，从今以后，终于会才会成为自己的妻子。
以后这一辈子，他会用尽一生所有的爱去疼她，爱她。
缓步到他的面前，顾少卿手捧着鲜花，深情的望着君雅思。
缓缓地单膝下跪，他目光虔诚的看着她。
“君雅思小姐，你愿意将你往后一生交给我吗？”
双眸的深情，像是要将她溺毙在其中一般。看着眼前的手捧花，君雅思的眼眶里突然溢出了眼泪。
只是，这眼泪却是温热而又幸福的。
她伸出手，接过他递上来的手捧花。
“我愿意。”
明知道她是愿意的，但是此刻听到这三个字的时候，顾少卿的心里还是被狠狠地震动着。
他起身，将手捧花递给君雅思。
“以后，你要对她好，若是欺负她，我们娘家人可是不会放过你的。”
君二叔此刻看着顾少卿，笑着说着这话，可是眼眶里还是禁不住红了。
那种生出舍不得女儿出嫁的情绪，将他整个心头给灌满。
但是却又想要让她往后余生都幸福美满。
虽然在回答着君二叔的话，但是他的一双眼睛恨不得就这样长在君雅思的身上了。
他的雅思真的好美，虽然之前见过她穿婚纱的样子了，但是此刻的她还是惊艳着他的眼眸，惊艳着他的心。
一旁的主持人插话，现场的气氛瞬间活跃了起来。
君二叔将君雅思的手交给了顾少卿，在这一刻，顾少卿紧紧地将她的手给拽着。
生怕自己松了之后，她就不见了似得。
这让君雅思的心里，更是觉得幸福。
那种幸福，好像整个人都晕乎乎的，好似脚踩在了云端。
誓词，交换戒指，在最后一刻礼成的时候，君雅思这才恍然，自己好像结婚了。
嫁给了这个自己深爱，并且也深爱着自己的男人。
她抬眸望去，却直接撞进了他深邃的眼波之中。
他的眼里有星星，就像是夜空之中那最璀璨的烟火，让忍不住深陷其中，再也无法分开。
现场掌声一片。
她这才回神，看着她仍旧与自己十指紧扣的手指，笑了起来。
那笑容是如此的灿烂，如此的幸福，如此的让人心底阵阵发暖。
结婚这件事情，其实挺累人的。
虽然婚礼是很幸福，也是所有女人的一个美梦。
content_en:
Chapter 1981 Finale
It made her unable to let go, and it was deeply ingrained in her heart.
Second Master Jun held Jun Yasi's hand, feeling very emotional at this moment. Apparently he did not expect that one day he would hold his niece's hand and send her to a happy place.
Although his daughter was not married yet, when he held Jun Yasi's hand and stood on the stage, he actually felt like a biological father.
If the eldest brother were alive, he would probably feel the same as himself at this moment.
They finally grew up and now married their beloved men and formed a new family.
I am relieved that my eldest brother and sister-in-law are still alive in heaven.
Their daughters are very good. Even if they make mistakes, they still choose to forgive.
If it weren't for their forgiveness, I wouldn't feel such emotions now.
Holding Jun Yasi's hand, he walked towards Gu Shaoqing step by step.
Petals are falling all over the sky, and the wedding scene is romantic and warm, filling people's hearts with happiness instantly.
Looking at Jun Yasi walking towards him, this woman he has loved for so many years will finally become his wife from now on.
In the rest of his life, he will use all the love in his life to love her and love her.
Slowly walking in front of him, Gu Shaoqing held flowers in his hands and looked at Jun Yasi affectionately.
Slowly kneeling down on one knee, he looked at her piously.
"Miss Jun Yasi, are you willing to leave the rest of your life to me?"
The deep affection in his eyes seemed to drown her in them. Looking at the bouquet of flowers in front of her, tears suddenly overflowed from Jun Yasi's eyes.
However, these tears are warm and happy.
She stretched out her hand and took the bouquet from him.
"I do."
He knew she was willing, but when he heard these three words, Gu Shaoqing's heart was still severely shaken.
He stood up and handed the bouquet to Jun Yasi.
"From now on, you have to be nice to her. If you bully her, our family will not let you go."
Second Uncle Jun looked at Gu Shaoqing and said this with a smile, but his eyes still couldn't help but turn red.
The emotion of being reluctant to let his daughter get married filled his whole heart.
But he also wants her to be happy for the rest of her life.
"Okay."
Although he was answering Uncle Jun's words, his eyes wished they could just be on Jun Yasi's body.
His IELTS was really beautiful. Although he had seen her in a wedding dress before, she still stunned his eyes and heart at this moment.
The host on the side interrupted, and the atmosphere instantly became lively.
Uncle Jun handed Jun Yasi's hand to Gu Shaoqing. At this moment, Gu Shaoqing held her hand tightly.
He was afraid that after he let go, she would disappear.
This made Jun Yasi feel even happier.
That kind of happiness makes everyone feel dizzy, as if they are stepping on the clouds.
When the vows and rings were exchanged at the last moment, Jun Yasi suddenly realized that she seemed to be married.
Married to this man whom I love deeply and who also loves me deeply.
She raised her eyes and looked directly into his deep gaze.
There were stars in his eyes, like the brightest fireworks in the night sky, which made one unable to help but fall deeply into them and never be able to separate.
There was a round of applause.
Only then did she come back to her senses, looked at her fingers that were still intertwined with hers, and smiled.
That smile was so bright, so happy, so heart-warming.
Getting married is actually quite tiring.
Although a wedding is very happy, it is also a dream for all women.
